name: Syclila's Mirror Shard
description: A sliver of the Empty Mirror, still cool with the reflection of whoever last struck it. Left behind when Syclila fell.

name: Silvered Glass Fragment
description: A fragment of silvered glass from Syclila's veil, showing a face that is never quite your own.

name: Reflection Dust
description: Fine dust that scatters light into a dozen false images. Gathered from Syclila's shattered mirror.

name: Mirrorkeeper's Veil Scrap
description: A scrap of the veil Syclila wore over the Entry Tower's summit. It reflects torchlight long after the torch is gone.

name: Twinned Gaze Stone
description: A stone with two eyes that watch each other. Prised from Syclila's mirror after her defeat.

name: Kikaru's Afterimage Wisp
description: A wisp of motion that never quite catches up to itself. All that remains where Kikaru once stood.

name: Tempo Shard
description: A shard that hums faster the longer you hold it, keeping a rhythm only Kikaru knew.

name: Blurred Step Fragment
description: A fragment of a footstep that landed in three places at once. Recovered after Kikaru was beaten.

name: Momentum Crystal
description: A crystal that stores the speed of everyone who fought Kikaru and lost.

name: Quickened Pulse Stone
description: A stone that beats a little faster than your heart, echoing Kikaru's endless tempo.

name: Celestia's Scale Fragment
description: A fragment of the golden scales Celestia used to weigh every climber. It still tilts toward the heavier soul.

name: Verdict Shard
description: A shard humming with a sentence never fully spoken. Left behind when Celestia's scales came to rest.

name: Halo Dust
description: Dust from the ring of light above Celestia's brow, gathered after her final measure.

name: Heaven's Gavel Splinter
description: A splinter of the gavel that ended a thousand climbs. Taken from Celestia after her defeat.

name: Weighed Soul Crystal
description: A crystal that shows the exact weight of whoever holds it, as Celestia's scales once did.

name: Bam's Reversed Current Shard
description: A shard where the tide runs backward, returning force to its owner. Left behind when Bam's still water finally broke.

name: Tide Core
description: The calm heart of a wave that never tired. Recovered from Bam after the Astral Tower fell silent.

name: Ignition Ember
description: An ember from the moment Bam's still water caught fire. It stays warm no matter how deep the water.

name: Absorbed Force Crystal
description: A crystal heavy with every blow Bam ever swallowed and gave back. Prised loose after his defeat.

name: Still Water Stone
description: A stone so calm it seems to still the air around it, echoing the quiet Bam kept before he struck.

name: Esteria's First Form Relic
description: A relic of the empress's gentle mask, the shape she wore to greet those who reached the summit.

name: Esteria's Second Form Core
description: The cold, immense heart of what stood up when the mask fell. The rarest trophy the towers hold.

name: Twin Shape Crystal
description: A crystal that holds two forms at once, neither willing to yield to the other, as Esteria did.

name: Eternal Empress Sigil
description: The sigil of the last thing the towers were built to keep. Only those who killed Esteria twice have held it.

name: Formshift Residue
description: Residue from the instant one form became another. Left behind when Esteria was finally ended.
